## Antigravity joins the notch
- **A new Antigravity circle.** It fills as you use your Gemini 5-hour limit, the same way Claude's ring follows its session. - **A full card on hover.** Hover the circle for four limits: Gemini session, Gemini weekly, Claude + GPT session and Claude + GPT weekly. Each shows its reset time, and the card also shows your account and plan. - **It stays on your Mac.** Usage comes straight from the Antigravity app over an encrypted local connection, and nothing is sent anywhere else. - **To turn it on:** open Antigravity, sign in, then switch Antigravity on in Settings.
## Choose the assistants you use
- **One switch per assistant in Settings.** On: the circle shows in the notch and its usage is read. Off: it leaves the notch and nothing is read. - **New installs start empty.** The notch shows a **Choose assistants** button that opens Settings. - **Updating?** The assistants you already had turned on stay on. Assistants you never turned on no longer appear as empty circles.
## Steadier
- **Antigravity closed:** the circle keeps its last reading, dimmed, and updates on its own when you reopen it. - **Signed out of Antigravity:** the card asks you to sign in instead of passing off an old reading as current. - **Switching Antigravity accounts:** no false "limit reset" or "limit reached" alerts. - **Account and plan names** with underscores or asterisks now display exactly as written. - **Flipping a switch quickly** on and off no longer leaves a stale approval behind.
